info.name: Blue hue
info.description: Step into a dreamy pastel blue world — a serene, whimsical space where soft hues whisper calmness and charm. Delicate shades of baby blue blend seamlessly with airy whites and subtle accents, creating a cute, cozy atmosphere that feels both refreshing and magical. Every element is wrapped in gentle tones, evoking a sense of purity, playfulness, and timeless elegance — like floating through a cloud-kissed wonderland
